about.description: We're a trusted roofing contractor built on quality craftsmanship, honest communication, and customer satisfaction. Based in Omaha, Nebraska, we specialize in roof installation, roof repair, roof replacement, storm damage restoration, siding installation, gutter cleaning, and attic venting. Professional roofing and exterior solutions built to protect your property.

image.alt: Advanced Roofing & Exteriors professional crew and roofing fleet

description: Advanced Roofing & Exteriors was founded on a simple belief: property owners deserve a roofing contractor they can trust. Homeowners worried about storm damage. Businesses needing reliable commercial roofing. Property managers dealing with aging exteriors. Everyone had the same problem — finding a contractor who would show up on time, communicate honestly, and deliver quality work at a fair price. That's where we come in.

We built Advanced Roofing & Exteriors with a commitment to quality craftsmanship and dependable service. Nebraska weather is demanding — high winds, hail, heavy rain, snow, and seasonal temperature changes all create wear and damage. Our team understands what it takes to protect homes and businesses with durable, long-lasting roofing and exterior systems.

Today, Advanced Roofing & Exteriors proudly serves Omaha, Bellevue, Sarpy County, Louisville, Plattsmouth, Valley, and surrounding Nebraska communities. From complete roof installations and replacements to storm damage restoration and siding solutions, we bring honest service, quality results, and lasting protection to every project.

section.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Straight answers about our roofing, storm damage, and exterior services.

items.question: How do I know if my roof needs repair or replacement?
items.answer: Schedule a free roof inspection. Our experts will assess the condition of your roof, identify any damage, and provide honest recommendations based on your roof's age, condition, and your budget.

items.question: Do you offer free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. Free, no-obligation estimates on every project. Call (402) 609-8072 for your quote — no hidden fees, ever.

items.question: Do you help with insurance claims?
items.answer: Yes. We specialize in storm damage restoration and provide full insurance claim assistance. We'll document damage, meet with adjusters, and help make the process as stress-free as possible.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: Omaha, Bellevue, Louisville, Plattsmouth, Valley, Sarpy County, and surrounding Nebraska communities.

items.question: How long does a roof replacement take?
items.answer: Most residential roof replacements are completed in 1-3 days depending on the size and complexity of the project. We'll provide a clear timeline before work begins.

items.question: Do you install siding?
items.answer: Yes. We provide professional siding installation and repair services to improve durability, energy efficiency, and curb appeal for your property.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Advanced Roofing & Exteriors is a fully licensed and insured roofing contractor committed to protecting your property and investment.

items.question: Do you clean gutters?
items.answer: Yes. Professional gutter cleaning services to prevent water damage and maintain proper drainage for your property.

items.question: How fast can you respond to storm damage?
items.answer: We provide fast response for storm damage emergencies. Call (402) 609-8072 and we'll schedule an inspection quickly to assess and address the damage.

items.question: Do you install attic ventilation?
items.answer: Yes. Proper attic ventilation installation and repairs to improve energy efficiency, prevent moisture issues, and extend the life of your roof.
